title: SetPropertyInterval payload
description: Typed payload for the set-property-interval operation kind (registry code 4). Set a typed property value over a valid-time interval on a slot. The payload shape here is the canonical contract for this op kind; the implementation is built to it. Encoded per the canonical-JSON profile: all fields present, absent optionals as null, UUIDs lower-case hyphenated, HLC and valid times as decimal strings, layer and value tags as stable lower names.

entity_id.description: Entity instance the slot belongs to.

valid_from.description: Interval start, epoch microseconds UTC as a decimal string.

hlc.description: Full-range HLC coordinate as a decimal string (canonical-JSON profile).

validTime.description: ValidTime as epoch microseconds UTC, encoded as a decimal string.

layer.description: Layer value tag as a stable schema-owned lower name.

value.description: Value tag: an object with exactly one stable schema-owned lower variant key. str|i64|f64|bool|time|ref|blob|json.

time.description: ValidTime as epoch microseconds UTC, decimal string.

blob.description: Byte array; large blobs are content-addressed, not inlined.
